```http
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes
Content-Type: application/json
x-apikey: <YOUR_API_KEY>

{
  "type": "vote",
  "attributes": {
    "verdict": "malicious"
  }
}
```

1. **Insert your API key** – If “key_four” is the name of the key you’re using, just put that key value in place of `<YOUR_API_KEY>`.
